title: Pitch a budget increase

outcome.label: Agreed
outcome.detail: Marcus responded best when you gave concrete numbers.

momentum.note: Momentum rose after you named a specific number.

moments.you_said: I think it's, um, kind of going to pay back pretty fast, because the team is really stretched right now.
moments.try_instead: It's, going to pay back fast, because the team is really stretched right now.
moments.why: A direct claim sounds more credible.

observations.note: You got more specific as the conversation went on.

next_step: Open with the number next time, then the reason.
